completedHikes.name: Old Rag Mountain
completedHikes.notes: Challenging rock scrambles, stunning 360° views. Best in fall for foliage.

completedHikes.name: Hawksbill Mountain
completedHikes.notes: Highest peak in Shenandoah NP. Short but steep climb.

completedHikes.name: Mary's Rock
completedHikes.notes: Great vista views, popular trail. Can be crowded on weekends.

completedHikes.name: Stony Man Mountain
completedHikes.notes: Quick hike with amazing views. Perfect for families and beginners.

completedHikes.name: The Loft Mountain
completedHikes.notes: Less crowded alternative with good views and wildflower spotting.

completedHikes.name: Dark Hollow Falls
completedHikes.notes: Beautiful waterfall hike. Very popular, arrive early for parking.

completedHikes.name: Whiteoak Canyon
completedHikes.notes: Six waterfalls along the trail. Great for photography.

completedHikes.name: Jones Mountain
completedHikes.notes: Longer hike, fewer crowds. Good endurance training.

completedHikes.name: Rough Ridge
completedHikes.notes: Boardwalk section with great views. Easy and rewarding.

completedHikes.name: Robertson Mountain
completedHikes.notes: Less traveled trail, quiet and peaceful. Good solitude hike.
